answer: Two conflicting liveness reports strand a newcomer on its own island shard, signal muted for one audit cycle. To rejoin the registry it must publish a signed sonnet, a fixed-form attestation whose lines each hash to its prior published state, and each relaying peer locks 500 POA beside it. Every fake identity pays 500 POA up front and forfeits that deposit on the first mismatched line, while honest shards relay free.
